species.name: Walleye
why: Water 60°F on top, a bit cool for them, so they feed in the warmest water they can find.
Best water today is 8–34 ft deep, mostly on channel edges.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 45 ft, cold below.
Little oxygen below about 65 ft, so fish stay above it.
Southeast wind at 10 mph pushes bait onto the northwest shore: try the wind-blown banks.
